paper.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
paper.summary: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated per token. We introduce Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architecture for efficient inference and cost-effective training. DeepSeek-V3 outperforms leading open-source models on math, coding, and benchmark evaluations.
